description: Verify that the Length field of the IPv4 Multicast Option is 0x0009 (SOME/IP-SD §5.1.2)
approach:
[Objective]
Wire-format invariant for the IPv4 Multicast Option: Length == 0x0009.

[Scenario — chronological]
DUT emits a qualifying SD message containing the option (typically an OfferService).
Observation: option's Length field == 0x0009.   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Length on the wire equals 0x0009.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_length — IPv4 multicast option length mismatch
• Fail_timeout — no qualifying SD message within listen window

verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying SD message within listen window
